items.title: Oltre le rughe: gli usi dell’acido ialuronico
items.summary: Oltre le rughe: gli usi dell’acido ialuronico
items.content:
Trasparente e un po' scivoloso, l'acido ialuronico è una molecola-spugna unica: ne basta un quarto di cucchiaino da tè per legare e trattenere poco meno di due litri di acqua. Questa proprietà speciale lo rende indispensabile al nostro organismo, che ne produce grandi quantità per tenere i tessuti ben idratati; così quando scarseggia, per colpa dell'età che avanza o a causa di disturbi e malattie, diventa spesso importante somministrarlo dall'esterno. Perché, per fortuna, abbiamo imparato a sintetizzarlo anche in laboratorio.. Come funziona e a cosa serve
L'acido ialuronico è una molecola sorprendente: è un polisaccaride, ovvero una lunga catena di piccole unità di uno zucchero che si ripetono e sono ricchissime di punti dove l'acqua può venire 'agganciata' con facilità. Riesce così a legarne fino a mille volte il suo peso, diventando super-idratante ovunque si trovi: per questo fra i tessuti più ricchi di acqua ci sono l'interno dell'occhio, le articolazioni (dove funziona come lubrificante per evitare attriti fra le ossa) o la pelle, che da giovane deve il suo aspetto liscio e compatto proprio all'abbondanza di acido ialuronico.
La sua conformazione a catena però non è solo una spugna per l'acqua: si comporta infatti anche come uno 'scheletro' su cui far crescere i tessuti e per questo è importante quando si devono riparare ferite e la ricerca ne sta indagando il ruolo negli embrioni e nello sviluppo; inoltre, gli spazi fra un'unità e l'altra del polimero di acido ialuronico possono accogliere anche altre molecole oltre all'acqua, rendendolo un ottimo 'veicolo' per portarle dove servono. Così, oggi se ne sta studiando l'uso non solo per la medicina rigenerativa, ma anche per formulazioni farmacologiche avanzate in grado di consentire il trasporto selettivo di terapie.. Dalla vista all'otorinolaringoiatria
Gli impieghi clinici dell'acido ialuronico, in continuo aumento da quando si è iniziato a usarlo ormai una sessantina di anni fa, sono perciò tanti e consolidati. Essendo fondamentale per sostenere la struttura dell'occhio, viene impiegato per esempio durante gli interventi chirurgici per proteggere i tessuti oculari interni; poiché idrata tantissimo ed è del tutto sicuro, è un componente essenziale delle lacrime artificiali per occhi secchi o che bruciano, ed è anche in grado di creare sulla cornea un film protettivo utile in caso di vento o polvere.
Prospettive ulteriori arrivano poi da ricercatori dell'Università dello Shandong a Jinan, in Cina, che analizzando i dati di varie ricerche nel settore hanno sottolineato come idrogel a base di acido ialuronico potrebbero essere utili anche in altre malattie oculari, dai traumi della cornea alla degenerazione maculare legata all'età, grazie a proprietà come la trasparenza ottica, la capacità di trasporto di farmaci e la completa biocompatibilità.. La stessa che rende l'acido ialuronico ampiamente usato in otorinolaringoiatria, per esempio per idratare le mucose di naso e gola nelle riniti allergiche e nelle rinosinusiti o in chirurgia, per proteggere le mucose e favorirne la cicatrizzazione e la ripresa: di recente uno studio su poco meno di 500 persone pubblicato su Otolaringoloy - Head and neck surgery ha dimostrato che in caso di timpanoplastica, l'intervento necessario a riparare un timpano perforato o danneggiato, l'uso di gel a base di acido ialuronico migliora gli esiti dell'operazione.. Benefici in ginecologia e in oncologia
L'effetto protettivo e rigenerante sulle mucose è anche il motivo per cui l'acido ialuronico è usato in ginecologia sotto forma di gel, ovuli e creme per contrastare la secchezza vaginale in menopausa e non solo, o anche per favorire la guarigione di micro-lesioni del tessuto vaginale; instillato direttamente nella vescica, è usato nelle cistiti croniche perché crea una specie di film protettivo sulla mucosa che riduce l'adesione dei batteri alle pareti, diminuendo anche l'irritazione connessa al contatto con le urine.
L'effetto è un miglioramento dei sintomi tale da poter considerare le instillazioni vescicali di acido ialuronico una terapia di prima linea in molti casi di cistiti interstiziali, stando a una recente ricerca dell'Unità di ginecologia dell'Università Campus Biomedico di Roma.. Per gli stessi motivi è utilissimo per accelerare la guarigione di lesioni alle mucose della bocca dovute a chemio o radioterapie in persone con tumori di vario genere: l'acido ialuronico riduce l'infiammazione e il bruciore, fa da barriera nei confronti del possibile effetto irritante da parte del cibo o della saliva, accelera la riparazione delle ferite.. Un'impalcatura per cicatrizzare la pelle
È vero per quelle connesse alle terapie oncologiche, ma anche per le ferite in genere: l'acido ialuronico funziona come un'impalcatura attorno a cui si ricostruiscono più facilmente i tessuti, perché forma una "rete umida" dove le cellule della pelle vengono guidate più rapidamente, vengono richiamati fibroblasti per produrre più collagene riducendo la cicatrice, viene stimolata la formazione di nuovi vasi sanguigni per trasportare ossigeno e nutrienti utili alla riparazione della pelle.. Gel, bendaggi e biomateriali avanzati a base di acido ialuronico sono usati perciò in caso di tagli, traumi superficiali ma anche per ustioni, ulcere e nel trattamento di ferite e suture chirurgiche, perché la guarigione accelera ed è più efficace, come ha sottolineato un documento dedicato alla medicina rigenerativa pubblicato su Nature.. Il ruolo nelle articolazioni e l'uso contro l'artrosi
È un po' più dibattuto invece l'uso di infiltrazioni di acido ialuronico, la cosiddetta viscosupplementazione, in caso di artrosi: l'attrito fra le ossa, nelle articolazioni, di norma viene ridotto dalla presenza di un 'lubrificante' a base di acido ialuronico che con l'età può diminuire.
La viscosupplementazione perciò è usata per ridurre il dolore e l'uso di antidolorifici; tuttavia i risultati degli studi scientifici non sono univoci - anche perché, come spesso accade con i dispositivi medici, sotto lo stesso nome si nascondono prodotti molto diversi tra loro -e cosi per esempio le linee guida 2026 dell'Istituto Superiore di Sanità sulla prevenzione della progressione dell'artrosi di anca e ginocchio hanno sottolineato l'incertezza e variabilità delle prove, indicando però che l'acido ialuronico produce comunque benefici 'piccoli ma desiderabili' sul dolore e la funzionalità dell'articolazione rispetto a un placebo o ai corticosteroidi come il cortisone, anche tenendo conto della sicurezza della terapia.. L'importanza del peso molecolare e delle nuove formulazioni
Parte dell'incertezza dipende dal fatto che "acido ialuronico" non è un prodotto unico, ma una famiglia eterogenea di dispositivi medici che differiscono per peso molecolare, reticolazione chimica e fonte di produzione.
Una revisione sistematica del 2023 su Cartilage mostra che queste differenze contano: l'acido ialuronico ad alto peso molecolare è l'unico a superare la soglia minima di beneficio clinicamente rilevante sul dolore, mentre le formulazioni reticolate o di origine aviaria sembrano più associate a reazioni infiammatorie locali. Molte metanalisi più datate hanno però trattato l'acido ialuronico come un'unica categoria - un limite che potrebbe spiegare, almeno in parte, la contraddittorietà dei risultati raccolti finora.. L'acido ialuronico infatti ha dalla sua una grande tollerabilità, specialmente se viene prodotto tramite biofermentazione, un processo che utilizza batteri e lo rende particolarmente puro. Inoltre, i metodi di sintesi sono migliorati e oggi con le formulazioni di acido ialuronico ibrido cooperativo si possono raggiungere concentrazioni molto elevate (con l'acido ialuronico lineare di prima generazione non si può aumentare troppo, perché diventa così viscoso da non passare attraverso una siringa) e si possono associare sostanze, come la condroitina sodica, che possono migliorare gli effetti della viscosupplementazione.. Trattamenti anti-age e rigenerazione cutanea
Gli stessi tipi "avanzati" di acido ialuronico sono anche i più utili per trattare la pelle, che negli strati del derma e dell'epidermide lo produce in quantità per restare elastica e compatta. Con gli anni però se ne forma sempre di meno e per questo la pelle diventa più secca, si rigenera con maggior lentezza, è meno protetta dai radicali liberi e si formano le rughe.
Restituirle dall'esterno l'acido ialuronico di cui ha bisogno aiuta a mantenerla sana a lungo, contrastando pure i segni del tempo: lo si fa per esempio con creme e gel che sono super-idratanti, specialmente se contengono acido ialuronico a basso e alto peso molecolare in modo da penetrare fino agli strati più profondi del derma.. E quando le rughe sono evidenti, per attenuarle sono proprio a base di acido ialuronico i filler più sicuri, oggi molto più duraturi grazie a formulazioni che utilizzano i cosiddetti complessi cooperativi stabili in cui molecole a basso e alto peso molecolare vengono stabilizzate con un processo termico, resistendo così più a lungo alla degradazione da parte degli enzimi cutanei per trattamenti che durano nel tempo.
Come sottolinea infatti Antonello Tateo, responsabile delll'Unità di Chirurgia Plastica dell'Istituto Auxologico Italiano di Milano, «L'acido ialuronico è da sempre un elemento chiave nei trattamenti di medicina estetica, grazie alla sua naturale presenza nei tessuti. Inizialmente utilizzato per aumentare i volumi e correggere le asimmetrie, ha trovato in seguito applicazione nella biorivitalizzazione, andando oltre la sola funzione filler. Oggi, con i nuovi complessi cooperativi stabili, si può ottenere un ringiovanimento visibile attraverso meccanismi che imitano la natura, agendo sulla matrice extracellulare che costituisce il sostegno di tutti i tessuti della pelle; potenziando il processo di rigenerazione tissutale, in un unico trattamento si può rimodellare, compattare e migliorare la qualità dei tessuti. Questa possibilità data dall'acido ialuronico di ultima generazione non sta soltanto ridefinendo gli standard della medicina estetica rigenerativa, ma anche cambiandone il paradigma: oggi si è passati infatti dalla correzione dell'imperfezione al benessere globale del paziente, in un approccio olistico che unisce salute e bellezza in modo armonico e rispettoso dell'unicità di ogni persona», conclude Tateo..

items.title: Lena Dunham's Girls to return for limited HBO run
items.summary: Ten years after the series finale, the "Girls" are getting back together to explore the "milestone of turning forty", HBO says.
items.content:
HBO's award-winning show Girls will return to screens for a limited run ten years after the series finale aired.

Lena Dunham – the show's creator, writer, and one of its stars – shared the announcement in a mock zoom call with members of the original cast Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet and Andrew Rannells.

All five actors, whose careers launched off the back of Girls, will be part of the five-episode revival with production set to begin in 2027. Judd Apatow, who helped get the show green lit with HBO, will also return as executive producer.

"We always said we would only return to 'Girls' if there was a specific story we were burning to tell," Dunham said in a statement.

"I've missed these characters, but for a long time I couldn't quite picture them in the present day," she said.

"Then, right around my 40th birthday, they started talking to me in the shower. And, as you may remember, once this fivesome starts talking it's pretty hard to get them to stop," she said.

Girls, which ran for six seasons from 2012 to 2017, was nominated for 19 Emmys and won two, including best casting.

It follows the lives of four friends – Hannah, played by Dunham, Marnie, played by Williams, Jessa, played by Kirke and Shoshanna, played by Mamet – living in New York City during their 20s.

The show, created by Dunham when she was 23-years-old, attracted both praise and controversy during its airing. The BBC ranked it as number 30 on its 100 Greatest TV Shows of the 21st Century.

"We're thrilled to have Lena turn her gaze from the tumult of one's twenties to the milestone of turning forty," Amy Gravitt, executive vice-president of HBO programming, said.

"To say the world has changed since we last saw Hannah, Marnie, Shoshanna, Jessa, and Elijah is a massive understatement, but we know fans - old and new - will be happy to see how they've grown and relieved to see that they're still the 'Girls' we knew way back when."

The title of the limited run has yet to be announced, but Dunham did ask her fellow cast on the mock zoom call, "can we still call it Girls?", before joking "because we're old as".

Other cast and production members, most notably actor Adam Driver, were absent from HBO's official statement. Driver, in his breakout role, played Dunham's on-and-off again love interest in the show.

In her 2026 bestselling memoir Famesick, Dunham alleged Driver's on-set behaviour at times turned verbally aggressive and physically imposing. Driver has not publicly commented on the allegations.

In Famesick, Dunham also wrote about the breakdown of her working relationship and friendship with co-showrunner and executive producer Jenni Konner. Konner is not included in HBO's statement about the show's revival.

Dunham wrote on her Substack that "it's rare in life that you get the chance to return to something you love with new knowledge and a ... ton of gratitude.

"I love these girls (and boy) and I love all the people who have reminded us afresh why we do this, which is the joy of being together and the chance to wear yellow mesh…" she wrote.

Since Girls ended, Dunham has gone on to create the Netflix series Too Much in 2025 and indie film Sharp Stick.

items.title: What we know about the deadly Six Flags rollercoaster incident in Georgia
items.summary: Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem died on Monday after police say he was ejected from a ride at an amusement park.
items.content:
A man has died after falling from a rollercoaster at a Six Flags amusement park on Monday in the US state of Georgia.

The man, Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, 42, was found dead under the ride after being ejected and hitting other people on it, according to police.

An investigation is under way and few details have yet to be released about what happened. Six Flags, the largest amusement park operator in North America, has temporarily closed nine rides across the US and Canada as a precaution.

The Cobb County Police Department said the incident at the Six Flags Over Georgia park happened just before 16:00 local time (20:00 GMT) on Monday.

"Officers working at the park responded to an incident involving a male guest on a roller coaster," it said in a statement on Tuesday.

"Preliminary information gathered through witness and employee interview indicates Kariem was ejected from the ride and struck other patrons before falling beneath the attraction."

The ride involved has not been specified but aerial footage from news helicopters showed the Goliath rollercoaster stopped midway, and multiple witnesses have identified the ride as the one involved in the incident.

The office of the state's insurance and fire safety commissioner, which enforces amusement park safety rules in Georgia, is also conducting a review.

The Goliath ride opened in 2006, and it has an elevation of 200ft (60m), a 170ft plunge, a 540-degree spiral, and a speed of up to 70mph (112km/h), according to the park website. On its "thrill scale", Six Flags ranks Goliath at level four out of five.

The company said in a statement that it was "deeply saddened by the guest incident" and that "our thoughts and heartfelt condolences are with the guest's family, friends, and loved ones".

Nick Mendenhall said he witnessed the fatal moments in disbelief, watching the man come out of his seat and then fall into another cart on the ride before falling to the ground.

"It was just super, super bizarre, traumatic. I mean, it took me a couple of seconds, I feel like, to process what was going on," he told the AP. "I cant believe that I just saw that."

He said his mind instantly went to the trauma of all of those impacted by what he witnessed, including the man's loved ones and everyone who was on the ride with him.

One witness told NBC affiliate WXIA that the incident was captured in souvenir photos that were automatically taken of the rollercoaster while it was in motion. The BBC has not been able to verify this statement.

Connor Thompson told the BBC's US partner CBS News that he was in line for the ride when everyone started "yelling, clearly distressed".

"Everyone was kind of confused at first, and then there was someone who was yelling, 'Call 911! Someone fell out!" he said. "At first it was almost like I didn't believe it because I thought that was like impossible for something like that to happen."

He said he saw the cart come into the hub where others were waiting in line and could see the restraint was unlatched.

Another witness, CiCi Nelson, told CNN she, too, was in line to ride the Goliath when the rollercoaster returned and she saw an empty seat with a loose safety bar and a female covered in blood.

Nelson described a scene of hysteria, adding that one man was "freaking out, saying someone fell off".

Brittany Landry, who believed she saw Kariem ejected from the rollercoaster, told Fox News she was in tears.

Kariem's family said he was a father, passionate educator and had survived two bouts of cancer.

His family told WXIA that he had survived cancer twice - the last stint in 2018 - and was in a car crash with his 10-year-old daughter three weeks before his death.

He lived in the nearby city of Atlanta and worked for Wesley International Academy, a public charter school, for more than 12 years as an IT manager, technology teacher and robotics coach.

"Mr. Kariem was deeply loved and respected, and his absence will be felt throughout our school community," the school said in a statement posted to its Facebook account.

"His love for Wesley, dedication to our students, and commitment to our school community were evident in everything he did."

Outside of work, Kariem enjoyed creating products with his laser engraver and 3D printers, as well as cooking, watching anime and spending time with family and friends, according to his profile on the school's website.

The death at Six Flags Over Georgia is at least the seventh there, according to the Doan Law Firm, which tracks amusement park accidents and represents victims.

According to the firm, this includes two people who had medical emergencies, two who were in restricted areas when they were struck by a ride, two who died in car-related accidents and one who died months after using the park's pool.

Six Flags operates 20 amusement parks, 14 water parks and nine resorts across Canada, the US and Mexico.

In the last 15 years, two deaths caused by falling from the park's rollercoasters led to lawsuits and settlements. One in 2011 involved an Iraq War veteran who was ejected from a ride in New York and hit his head on the car. In the other, in 2013, a woman slipped from her restraints on a rollercoaster in Texas and fell 75 feet.

In September, the Six Flags Magic Mountain park in California announced it was closing its X2 rollercoaster after more 100 people alleged that they had suffered brain injuries from the ride.

Horrified witnesses recount fatal rollercoaster incident at Six Flags

One person has died and several others were injured after an incident on a rollercoaster at an amusement park in the US state of Georgia.

Six Flags Over Georgia park officials said staff found the man, identified as 42-year-old Atlanta resident Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem, beneath the ride. He was unresponsive and not breathing.

Witnesses have spoken about the incident and its aftermath, with one man who was on the ride describing it as "super bizarre, traumatic".

items.title: Zimbabwean author denies using AI to write award-winning story
items.summary: Simbarashe Kundizeza was responding to an accusation that has caused an uproar on social media.
items.content:
Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied using artificial intelligence (AI) to write his short story, which won this year's Caine Prize for African Writing.

His statement comes a week after he scooped the £10,000 ($13,000) award and a recent article in The Atlantic said AI-detection software Pangram had shown his work about a boy whose family falls on hard times was entirely AI generated.

"For the avoidance of doubt, I wrote The Blue Fighter," he posted on X , external .

The accusation has caused an uproar on social media and Caine Prize chair Ellah Wakatama told the BBC she was shocked that the US magazine had not waited for a full investigation before publishing.

"I do wish The Atlantic had spent more time investigating this so that alongside Pangram, they did have evidence of real human investigation of it before tainting the prize and tainting this winner," Wakatama told the BBC's Front Row programme .

The chair of the Caine Prize's board of trustees said she had been contacted on Friday about the allegation and Vauhini Vara's article - Yet Another Prizewinner Seems to Be AI , external - had been published on Sunday.

It follows rows over other literary prizes this year, in particular the Commonwealth Short Story Prize, which was won by Trinidadian writer Jamir Nazir despite allegations that he had used AI, and the withdrawal of Canadian-Haitian author Thélyson Orélien from France's top literary award, the Goncourt, over allegations he used AI for his first novel, which he denies .

Vara, who quoted Wakatama in her article, said her wariness of Silicon Valley was "well founded and reasonable" but she said Pangram's internal research showed its assessments were rarely wrong.

The backlash to the article on social media has included comments from African writers with suggestions that such accusations are primarily being made against non-white writers.

Wale Lawal, the Nigerian founder of The Republic magazine, called out The Atlantic article for being "crazy, racist and wildly unethical" , external .

Zimbabwean writer Joe Ruzvidzo, whose novel Welcome to Anywhere came out last year, said he stood by Kundizeza and that it was time "to fight this literary stop-and-frisk" , external .

Nigerian publisher Modupe Daramola said it was necessary to discuss how "these AI allegations are targeting Black and African writers" and how they were often disproportionately scrutinised.

"There's something incredibly sinister about this," the Noisy Streetss Limited publisher posted on X , external .

"Pangram is itself AI-powered. Why should its assessment be treated as definitive?" she added.

Wakatama said as part of an internal investigation for the Caine Prize Kundizeza would be sending in documentation about his various drafts and there were ongoing conversations with all the judges and The Shallow Tales Review, the publication that first published The Blue Fighter in 2025 , external .

In his statement, Kundizeza said had "a concrete, documented history" about the story's inspiration and he set out the chronology of its development.

Wakatama, who is also editor-at-large at Canongate Books, said Caine Prize submissions, which are all previously published, were not checked for AI, but writers vouched that their work was original.

She added that she was not against using AI per se to check entries, but she was "against is it being used as a final arbiter in this case".

Wakatama said it was also important to remember Pangram was "not yet tested".

"I am not happy for the work of writers, and in this case especially black writers, to form the testing ground for something that is at best still rough and ready."

Research has found that AI detectors can wrongly flag human writing as AI generated. Vara conceded that any AI-detection product, "including one as good of Pangram" was "not going to be 100% accurate".

In her article, as well as citing Pangram research she also quoted a recent paper by researchers at Free University of Brussels , external , which said it had found zero cases of Pangram, and two other AI-detection tools, getting it wrong when it came to English-language writing by non-native English speakers.

The study notes that tools like Pangram should be considered "as an initial flag for further investigation".

Vara told BBC's Front Row programme that she had also used her own judgment "to suss out these things" and that every other previous Caine Prize winning story she had put through Pangram "came out as 100% human".

"I also found an earlier 2021 story by the same author. I ran that through Pangram. It also came out as 100% human. And what struck me was that was a really good, interesting story. And tonally, it's so different from this story, as if the same person hadn't written both."

In response Kundizeza wrote: "To suggest that a writer cannot write in different styles or genres, or improve his writing substantially after five or more years fundamentally misunderstands the craft of writing."

For Vara, one of the stylistic issues that stood out about The Blue Fighter was that it had used sentence constructions using "X but Y", which she says is common in AI-generated texts.

"Not with anger, but with the quiet resignation of someone who had known all along this moment would come," is an example she gave from the story that described the character of the mother.

"The proliferation of those struck me," Vara told Front Row, adding that the story also had a lot of metaphors, also prevalent in writing generated by AI.

The day after winning the Caine Prize, Kundizeza told the BBC he was inspired after hearing a poem read by South African Vangile Gantsho at an event in Ghana last year about her father's obsession with building fish tanks.

He said he had weaved that with fictionalised details from his own life around 2002 when Zimbabwe's economic troubles began.

"Much like the father in the story, my own dad... was an accountant, but he quit his job to grow tomatoes. So it kind of touches on both of our fathers," he told BBC Newsday.

On X, Kundizeza said he was heartened by "the numerous messages of solidarity from fellow writers and readers", ending his message by saying: "Most importantly, I will continue to write."

items.title: Grace Hopper Celebration Cancelled
items.summary: Article URL: https://anitab.org/press-release Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50080007 Points: 194 # Comments: 136
items.content:
It is with deep regret that we are announcing the cancellation of this year’s Grace Hopper Celebration in Anaheim, CA.

This is not a decision we made lightly; we understand it leaves many of our community disappointed. It is a function of not having the funds required to move forward with the Celebration, unlike in years past. Unlike past events, this year, both individual registrations and sponsorship commitments came in significantly below our expectations and, ultimately, below the level needed to cover critical operating expenses.

We know this decision affects far more than an event. Many of you have made travel arrangements, booked hotels, received visas, secured time away from work, organized teams, and planned important moments around being together. We are deeply sorry for the disruption this creates.

If you have plans to attend GHC, please take the following steps now:

To our attendees, sponsors, speakers, volunteers, partners, and everyone who has invested in making Grace Hopper Celebration possible: we are profoundly grateful, and profoundly sorry.

GHC has always been about more than a place or a moment on the calendar. It is about a community that has spent decades opening doors, expanding opportunity, and making sure women technologists have a voice in shaping the future of technology.

GHC has been central to our mission, and the circumstances leading to its cancellation have adversely affected our finances. We are evaluating strategic alternatives and the type of programming we can offer in the future. I anticipate further announcements will be made in the coming weeks as we gain greater clarity on key variables.

AnitaB.org has determined that it will not have the funds required to pay the costs of producing the Celebration. This year, both individual registrations and sponsorship commitments came in significantly below prior years and, ultimately, below the level required to cover basic operating expenses.

Information regarding GHC registration and other financial matters will be communicated to you promptly once we obtain a clearer understanding of AnitaB.org ’s financial condition.

We encourage you to review cancellation and refund eligibility with your travel and accommodation provider. Many providers offer more flexibility the earlier a change is requested.

AnitaB.org is unable to advise on immigration matters. Please consult a qualified immigration attorney or your sponsoring institution.

Employers who had scheduled interviews are being notified, and we are asking them to continue those conversations directly where possible.

Your A nitaB.org contact is reaching out directly. Information regarding sponsorships, exhibitor commitments, and related financial matters will be communicated to the organizations affected. For anything urgent, please use GHC@AnitaB.org .

Updates will be posted on the GHC website, the most recent updates will appear at the top of the Press Release page.

Please use GHC@AnitaB.org for anything related to the cancellation. Using one address allows us to centralize inquiries and respond as effectively as possible.

items.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia- Zelensky: “Raid su centrale termoelettrica, alleati non ci hanno avvertito”
items.summary: Kiev: “Rilevate restrizioni a versione militare di Starlink”. Il capo dell’Fbi Patel oggi in Russia. Trump: “Condividiamo ancora l’intelligence con Kiev, li aiutiamo”
items.content:
I membri della Nato dovrebbero preparare una risposta decisa a un possibile attacco 'ibrido' letale da parte della Russia. E’ l’allarme del ministro degli Esteri polacco Radoslaw Sikorski al Financial Times , sottolineando che la probabilità che qualcuno venga ucciso sta aumentando con l'intensificarsi delle operazioni russe di destabilizzazione.

L'Ue eroga a Kiev una nuova tranche da 2,8 miliardi in aiuti militari

Sul supporto all'Ucraina e in particolare alle limitazioni all'uso dei satelliti Starlink per le forze armate ucraine, "credo che il presidente sia stato molto chiaro ieri, quando ha rilasciato brevi dichiarazioni ai media mentre lasciava la Casa Bianca per un evento elettorale, e ha affermato che la condivisione di informazioni di intelligence non si è interrotta". Lo ha dichiarato il segretario generale della Nato, Mark Rutte, in conferenza stampa a Tallinn con il premier Estone, Kristen Michal, rispondendo a una domanda in merito.

La Russia sta ancora valutando "attentamente" la linea degli Stati Uniti sull'Ucraina per capire se sia cambiata. A riferirlo è stato il portavoce del Cremlino Dmitri Peskov. "E' ancora prematuro concludere che Washington abbia modificato il proprio approccio al sostegno militare a Kiev", ha detto a quanto riporta la Tass.

L'Ue eroga a Kiev una nuova tranche da 2,8 miliardi in aiuti militari

Oggi la Commissione europea ha erogato 2,86 miliardi di euro all'Ucraina nell'ambito della componente "difesa" del prestito di sostegno da 90 miliardi di euro. I fondi saranno destinati all'acquisto di droni, sistemi di difesa aerea, missili, radar, sistemi di guerra elettronica e munizioni.

"Non credo che la scelta americana" di revocare le sanzioni sul diesel russo "agevoli questa situazione che punta a portare Putin al tavolo della pace. Quindi condivido le parole del Presidente del Consiglio, è una decisione che abbiamo preso in comune. Mi aveva consultato ieri su questa posizione, sulla quale oggi ha trovato un mio pieno sostegno". Lo ha affermato il ministro degli Esteri Antonio Tajani a Villa Madama, a margine dell'incontro con il presidente dominicano Luis Abinader, commentando le parole della premier Giorgia Meloni che ha definito la scelta del presidente Usa Donald Trump "molto rischiosa". "L'Unità dell'Occidente è fondamentale. L'Europa ieri ha deciso di infliggere nuove sanzioni a oltre 1.500 appartenenti alla difesa russa", ha ricordato il titolare della Farnesina.

Media, Kiev propone incontro a Bruxelles a Witkoff e Kushner

I negoziatori ucraini hanno invitato gli inviati del presidente statunitense Donald Trump a incontrarsi nei prossimi giorni. Lo afferma Rbc. "I negoziatori ucraini stanno ora invitando Steve Witkoff e Jared Kushner a recarsi a Bruxelles o in un'altra città per un nuovo ciclo di negoziati", hanno affermato le fonti. Questa settimana è in programma una riunione del Consiglio europeo a Bruxellesal quale parteciperà Volodymyr Zelensky.

"Il Consiglio europeo si rammarica della decisione degli Stati Uniti di revocare temporaneamente le sanzioni sul diesel russo". Lo si legge nella bozza delle conclusioni - di cui l'AGI ha preso visione - del vertice Ue che si terrà giovedì e venerdì a Bruxelles. "L'Unione europea resta determinata ad aumentare ulteriormente la pressione sulla Russia affinché ponga fine alla sua brutale guerra di aggressione e avvii negoziati concreti verso la pace", si legge ancora nel testo, in cui il Consiglio europeo "accoglie con favore la recente adozione del 21 pacchetto di sanzioni e di un numero considerevole di ulteriori inserimenti in elenco di persone ed entità" e chiede "un'attuazione rapida ed efficace delle misure riguardanti gli ex combattenti russi, nonché ulteriori misure, in coordinamento con i partner, anche al fine di ridurre le entrate energetiche della Russia, di colmare efficacemente le lacune e contrastare l'elusione, e di limitare le operazioni della flotta ombra e comprometterne il modello economico".

Società elettrica: “Kiev, Kharkiv, Sumy senza luce dopo raid russi”

A seguito dell'attacco russo al settore energetico, i consumatori di Kiev, così come quelli delle regioni di Kharkiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Khmelnytskyi e Zaporizhia, sono senza elettricità questa mattina. Lo riferisce la società elettrica ucraina Ukrenergo, come riportano i media locali.

Il data center della banca statale russa Sberbank a Balakovo, nella regione di Saratov (600 chilometri ad est del confine ucraino) è stato attaccato dalle forze armate di Kiev. "Tutti i servizi sono operativi normalmente", ha dichiarato da Aleksandr Vedyakhin, vicepresidente del consiglio di amministrazione di Sberbank, ripreso dalle agenzie russe. In precedenza, il governatore della regione di Saratov, Roman Busargin, aveva informato dell'attacco alla regione, avvenuto questa mattina presto, nel corso del quale una persona è rimasta uccisa.

Aeronautica Kiev: “Niente alert dei partner nel primo attacco, negli altri 3 sì”

Durante la prima ondata dell'attacco russo della scorsa notte i partner non hanno l'Ucraina dell'uso di missili balistici; gli avvertimenti sono stati ricevuti nelle tre ondate successive. Lo ha annunciato in tv, riporta Ukrinform, il portavoce dell'Aeronautica militare ucraina Yuriy Ignat. "Una piccola precisazione sulla questione se ci sia stato o meno un rapporto. A molti interessa sapere se i partner abbiano fatto delle segnalazioni. Intorno alle 22:40 abbiamo riferito che non c'erano state segnalazioni sull'uso di armi balistiche da parte dei partner, ma nelle tre ondate successive di attacchi sono giunte segnalazioni da parte dei partner sull'uso di armi balistiche", ha affermato.

Il funzionamento di alcuni terminali internet di Starlink sembra essere stato limitato durante la notte, dopo che il presidente statunitense Donald Trump aveva chiesto una pausa negli attacchi alle infrastrutture energetiche. "Questa sera SpaceX ha introdotto un limite di velocità per i terminali Starlink in movimento", ha dichiarato il consigliere del presidente Volodymyr Zelensky, Sergiy Beskrestnov. "Le nostre forze di difesa non erano state avvertite di questa restrizione, il che ha portato all'interruzione di diverse missioni. Ovviamente- ha sottolineato - questa azione non può essere una coincidenza ed è legata all'attuale situazione politica".

Zelensky: “almeno 600 mila persone rimaste senza elettricità”

"Purtroppo, almeno 600.000 persone sono ora senza elettricità. Le interruzioni potrebbero estendersi ulteriormente". Lo afferma su X il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky. "Sfortunatamente, si registrano danni significativi a impianti e attrezzature - aggiunge - 26 impianti del nostro sistema energetico e quattro impianti nel settore petrolifero e del gas. Sono grato alle squadre di riparazione, a tutti i lavoratori del settore energetico ucraino e al personale del Servizio statale di emergenza dell'Ucraina per tutti gli sforzi profusi per affrontare le conseguenze di questo attacco russo. Tragicamente, ci sono state vittime e feriti".

Zelensky: “Attacco russo deliberata mancanza di rispetto per gli Usa”

"La Russia non ha mai mostrato prima d'ora una mancanza di rispetto così ostentata nei confronti degli Usa, non considera ferme le dichiarazioni del presidente americano". Così su X il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky. Quello della scorsa notte è stato un attacco "del tutto deliberato e dimostrativo nella sua portata, un attacco missilistico balistico russo mirato specificamente contro le infrastrutture energetiche, proprio quelle tutelate dal cessate il fuoco annunciato dal presidente Usa. La Russia ha sprecato l'opportunità di una de-escalation e ha chiaramente scelto di continuare la sua folle guerra di annientamento".

Sei centrali termoelettriche sono state bombardate la scorsa notte dalle forze russe nelle regioni di Kiev e Kharkiv, secondo quanto riferito dal ministero della Difesa di Mosca. E questo nonostante l'annuncio del presidente Usa Donald Trump su una presunta tregua energetica tra Mosca e Kiev. Due di questi impianti, le centrali Darnitskaya e Kievskaya, sono state colpite nella capitale, due nella regione della stessa Kiev e altre due a Kharkiv e nella sua regione. Bombardato anche il centro dati ATM Ukrsibbank, che gestiva il traffico internet a Kiev.

Un attacco russo con missili balistici ha provocato tre morti e 21 feriti, tra cui un bambino di otto anni, a Kiev. Lo riferisce il sindaco della capitale ucraina, Vitaly Klitschko, riporta Ukrinform. Un missile ha colpito un edificio residenziale di nove piani nel distretto di Desnianskyi e ha causato un incendio, ha spiegato Klitschko.

La contraerea russa ha abbattuto altri 15 droni diretti verso Mosca, in aggiunta alla settantina intercettata durante la scorsa giornata. Lo riferisce il sindaco di Mosca, Serghei Sobyanin

Zelensky: “Raid su centrale termoelettrica a Kiev, alleati non ci hanno avvertito”

L'attacco russo sulla capitale ha preso di mira anche la centrale termoelettrica numero 4, uno dei principali impianti energetici di Kiev. "Per la seconda volta consecutiva, i partner non ci hanno avvertito, e i missili sono stati individuati solo mentre si avvicinavano alla città". Lo afferma il presidente ucraino Volodymyr Zelensky sui social.

items.title: Pakistan has locked down Imran Khan's stronghold - but it could backfire
items.summary: Some fear the government's standoff with the former PM's supporters could bring more instability, not less.
items.content:
Schools closed. The internet partially shut. Roads blocked by shipping containers. And the army arriving in town.

Imran Khan's party stronghold, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, is under a state of emergency, his party's provincial government suspended. It's another dramatic escalation in the standoff between the former prime minister's supporters and Pakistan's state - and one that some fear could lead to more instability, not less.

According to the federal government this step, allowed by the constitution, was needed to provide protection for the province's population from the threat of terror.

"The PTI KPK government was hand in glove with the terrorists," Attah Tarrar, federal information minister, told journalists on Sunday. He did not elaborate or provide evidence, but promised to do so soon.

Two days later there had still been no update from him - but schools had reopened in Peshawar and most parts of the province, and internet services had been restored.

While police would not confirm any detentions, there is clearly a crackdown under way to prevent protests. Most PTI leaders in the province have gone into hiding.

On Tuesday dozens of PTI supporters took to the streets in Bara, Khyber district, hometown of provincial Chief Minister Sohail Afridi. There were reports of tear gas shelling in the area.

To many observers, the timing of Sunday's announcement of emergency rule is not coincidental.

For the last week, thousands of Imran Khan's supporters have marched through Khyber Pakhtunkhwa , where the PTI have been in power for 13 years, demanding Khan's release.

"The charitable response would be to say that it sounded disingenuous," says Farzana Sheikh, associate fellow at Chatham House.

"I do not see the link with terrorism," says Arifa Noor, journalist and commentator. "I'm not even sure if it was the long march itself [that led to this]. Perhaps it was the last straw or perhaps it's just a case of saying, we don't want to deal with the government being in the hands of an opposition party."

The protests were led by Chief Minister Afridi, whose whereabouts are still a mystery. His party says he has been arrested; the government says that he is in protective custody.

Before the march had begun, there had been a crackdown. Three of Khan's sisters were arrested in September , accused among other things of mobilising supporters, and have been detained ever since.

Khan has barely been seen by his family or lawyers in the last year; two of his sisters saw him in August, one in prison, another as he was checked over at a hospital visit after concerns were raised by the Supreme Court about his health, before he was returned behind bars again where he has been held for more than three years.

The PTI leader, who is widely believed to have lost power because of a rift with Pakistan's powerful military, has been imprisoned since August 2023. He is convicted in several corruption cases which he says are politically motivated.

With the party already weakened, why this reaction from the authorities?

"The PTI rank and file has been becoming increasingly restless in recent months amid growing concerns about Imran Khan's health," says Michael Kugelman, senior South Asia fellow at the Atlantic Council.

"There is a sense that perhaps now is the time to send a very strong message to the party and make it more difficult for them to be able to put pressure on the government."

The government has previously argued that Khan was going against jail rules by using his meetings to discuss politics.

Tarar has said of the state of emergency: "There was no political agenda. They could have gone on with their march," and pointed to the talks the two sides had in the run-up to the decision as an indicator that they did try discussion.

But others see this as just another attempt to restrict Khan and his party.

"The government has less and less space for disagreements or dissent and they do not want to negotiate their way out of any kind of conflict," Noor says.

Zahid Hussain, Islamabad-based author and defence analyst, is clear about who is behind the decision.

"The balance of power is completely shifted to the military establishment," he says.

Sheikh thinks that Pakistan's military is feeling confident because it believes it has a good relationship with the White House, its international credentials burnished by their role in the US-Iran peace talks.

"The mode is very much, this is the moment, let's seize it," she says. "There is a sense that, we have all the cards in our hands. We can ride this out internationally."

Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan

Imran Khan not the only one silenced as Pakistan military stifles dissent

But Pakistan has plenty to contend with. Militancy is rising. The country was ranked number one in the Global Terrorism Index 2026 as the country which had been affected most.

The country is at loggerheads with two neighbours; it has repeatedly hit Afghanistan with air strikes accusing the Afghan Taliban government of harbouring militant groups, a claim it denies. It would take little to reignite its long-running simmering conflict with India.

Meanwhile, it has promised to help Saudi Arabia defend itself against attacks as the conflict against the Houthis has become increasingly dangerous.

Short of solving one problem, some have warned this state of emergency could lead to more challenges. It risks increasing political instability, with Islamabad taking responsibility for a province without a buffer - the provincial government - they can blame.

"I would argue that this could actually backfire," Kugelman says. "You're playing with fire because if this move ends up adding to the anger and the discontent among so many there, then you have a very big problem on your hands."

"It is reckless, given the challenges, multiple challenges the country is facing," Hussain says. He fears that more of these powers could be used across Pakistan.

Attempts to combat militancy with more active army operations could come with its own perils too, Sheikh argues.

"If they're going to launch these operations, they're going to have to be prepared to accept casualties of members of the armed forces," she says. If those are significant, it could lead to questions inside the military institution, she adds.

Pakistan, with its history of military coups, has examples in its past where removing elected governments, whether provincial or national, can turn sour.

"It's not that senior people in the PML-N [the party in federal government] don't realise that some of these things can come back and haunt them in the future," Noor says.

"Similarly I think to some extent the PTI realises that they will not be able to hold a protest and get Imran Khan out. I think that's the most unfortunate part of this mess that we're in, that we are going into it with our eyes wide open.

"Everybody realises that this is a train crash but somehow you can't stop it."

items.title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely
items.summary: As loneliness grows in China, a new industry is emerging to provide companionship and support.
items.content:
"The biggest difficulty really was the loneliness. Sometimes, if I wanted to talk to someone I'd talk to the TV."

Yang, 91, lives on the outskirts of China's bustling capital Beijing. Following the death of her husband, she was so lonely that she says she even considered the possibility of voluntary euthanasia.

"I asked my son about it but he told me it was banned. I told him that if it ever becomes legal I want to do it - I didn't want to live any longer."

Suffering glaucoma, with failing eyesight, she was unable to even do basic things like adjust the controls on her air conditioner.

Cases such as Yang's have become increasingly common in Chinese cities which Associate Professor Teresa Kuan, from the Chinese University of Hong Kong, says is "exacerbated by the structure of society and the modes by which people interact".

There are many causes of isolation in China. Like when rural migrants pursue economic opportunities, leaving behind close-knit support networks for urban centres where loneliness and uncertainty can be difficult to overcome, or when graduates uproot themselves chasing employment on the other side of the country.

But now a growing "loneliness industry" has emerged to try to fill these gaps in people's lives.

Yang says her life has been transformed by one of these services - Wang Yingwei and his electric scooter delivery team - who started coming over twice a day with hot meals but whose help extends far beyond that.

"We see ourselves as community children," Yingwei told the BBC. "It means putting yourself in the shoes of older people and carefully considering their needs.

"For example, they may be drinking tap water which can be cloudy and contain a lot of lime. I can fix this problem with a filtered water tank. Such a small thing can make them much happier. Maybe they can't shower because their equipment is broken. I'll buy a part, replace it and their shower is fine."

"The elderly treat us like their children, and we treat them like our own parents," he added.

Yingwei's services cost less than half the price of employing a caregiver.

The former mobile phone salesman says he started his company to help seniors remain at home without having to move into retirement facilities. He was inspired to do this after his own father-in-law, who had developed Alzheimer's, had to go into a nursing home. Yingwei said he felt that the conditions there were so sub-standard he wanted to make sure others could stay out of institutions like this for as long as possible.

His small business currently employs four people but he says there is a possibility he will expand as demand grows.

There is still a shortage of solid data on the size of this sector – which operators say has exploded in recent years – but securities company Sinolink valued it at around $7.4 billion in 2025. And this is only expected to grow given the trajectory of modern lifestyles.

Zheng Ruizhi, another client of Yingwei's who lives in Beijing's northern outskirts, welcomed him at the door with a big smile.

"After retiring, I don't have much opportunity to hang out with others," the 75-year-old, whose son lives two hours away from her, told the BBC.

She was recovering from a recent injury which she said was making everyday tasks more difficult.

But the arrival of Yingwei – who she calls her "dear boy" – lightened her mood.

"I call you 'dear boy' because I am so fond of you. I genuinely like you from the bottom of my heart. I also admire and trust you. When you help me out, I don't have a single worry or fear," she told him.

Yet the services offered by those in this sector are not limited to home visits.

Twenty-three-year-old Liu Yanyan, for instance, works as a "medical escort". She acts as a friendly face taking clients to see the doctor, or picking up their test results or medication from city hospitals, which can be intimidatingly large and bureaucratic.

"Some of my customers are people in their 20s who came to Beijing to build a career. They might not have friends here or feel awkward asking colleagues to accompany them because of the concept of social reciprocity in Chinese culture," she said. "If I accompanied you to a doctor's appointment for free, you might feel obligated to buy me a meal or a movie ticket afterwards."

She said that, because of this, there are many people in modern Chinese society who tend to keep to themselves.

"So, they hire someone like me to accompany them to the hospital. If they had to go alone, they could feel scared or anxious."

At the core of many businesses catering to loneliness in China is a simple offering: human connection.

Teresa Kuan said that some people prefer the option of pouring their hearts out to a complete stranger for a fee.

"If there is a companion you have paid for, the relationship is not exactly equal. It is a service relationship, so you don't have to deal with the unpredictability of a standard relationship. The thing about friendship is that it can be unpredictable. You don't know when someone might disappoint you. But, in a service relationship, you have a better idea of what to expect."

Wang Zhoutao runs a hiking business to help people who want to climb China's famous mountain Huangshan in Anhui Province.

"We provide emotional support, like cheering them up, taking their photo or telling jokes. It's really a service based on companionship," he said.

The former soldier added that he normally hikes up the mountain with clients 10 to 15 days a month. When fully booked, this could be as many as 30 times a month.

He gave an example of a young woman he once accompanied who felt ostracised at work. "She felt useless and wanted to prove something to herself," he said.

"We started climbing but it was a tough trek as the weather was really hot and we were sweating a lot. There were moments she wanted to give up but I told her, 'If you quit now and can't get over this mountain how will you handle anything else in life?'. I kept encouraging her."

After they made it all the way he said she sent him a long message of thanks describing her inner journey and expressing her gratitude.

"The pace of life is just too fast these days. People face pressure from work, relationships and family expectations," he said. "I think my clients are mostly people who feel a void in their relationships or have suffered a setback."

Human connection is a necessity but, in a society grappling with loneliness across generations, it has now also become a commodity.

Back in her little Beijing flat, Yang is feeling more comfortable now that Yingwei has sorted out her problem of making the air conditioner work properly.

"It's good to have someone around when you need it, someone you can share your innermost thoughts with," she said.

"I did struggle with loneliness but that's been resolved now. I'm quite happy.

"I can't lose Yingwei and the others. They've all got a good heart."

items.title: Who's to blame for the toxic haze choking South East Asia?
items.summary: Anger is mounting at the companies accused of burning land in Indonesia and the authorities who have failed to stop them.
items.content:
As Indonesia battles its worst wildfire season in a decade, a toxic smog is choking millions of residents in the region.

The air on the islands of Kalimantan and Sumatra has turned an ominous amber, with air quality recorded at hazardous levels.

The smog - or haze - has drifted beyond Indonesia's borders to neighbouring countries, raising public health concerns. It has obscured Singapore's skyline and forced some schools to close in Malaysia.

Now, anger is mounting at the companies accused of burning farmland, as well as the authorities who have struggled to stop them.

The annual dry season wildfires have been especially intense this year because of an unusually strong El Niño: a natural climate phenomenon which changes weather patterns around the world.

According to independent forest monitoring platform Nusantara Atlas, 1,043,377 wildfire hotspots have been recorded in Indonesia, burning a total of 900,000 hectares of land.

Many of these fires in Indonesia's forests and peatlands are caused by the razing of vegetation to clear land - a practice known as "slash and burn".

This is an agricultural method that has traditionally been employed by farmers in Indonesia to create nutrient-rich soil for new crops.

But today, many of these fires are associated with commercial farming and are taking place on a much larger scale - and are harder to control. Activists and government investigations have repeatedly accused some companies of using fire as a cheap way to clear large swathes of land.

While slash-and-burn farming is illegal in Indonesia, enforcement of a ban has long proven tricky.

But persistent haze this year has prompted Indonesian authorities to step up efforts to punish offenders.

Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has called for tougher sanctions against slash-and-burn farming, describing the practice as "ecological terrorism".

Last month, Indonesian authorities announced they had suspended the operating licences of 26 companies linked to the wildfires and launched investigations into others. Cases involving criminal elements would be taken to court, officials vowed.

But it's not just Indonesian companies that have been embroiled in controversy over the haze.

A Greenpeace report published this month identified businesses based in Singapore and Malaysia which are linked to plots of land in Indonesia where wildfires are burning.

This includes First Resources, a Singapore-based palm oil company. Between August and September more than 30 haze source points were recorded on land managed by its two Indonesian subsidiaries, according to Greenpeace.

First Resources told the BBC in a statement that it maintained a "strict zero burning policy across all planting activities and implements robust fire prevention, monitoring and firefighting measures throughout our operations".

Greenpeace also named Malaysian plantation group Kuala Lumpur Kepong, whose subsidiary PT Menteng Jaya Sawit Perdana managed land in Indonesia where 19 haze source points were recorded.

Kuala Lumpur Kepong said in a statement that a "majority" of the fires originated from beyond its concession area and had all been extinguished.

"We do not condone or permit the use of open burning for land preparation or any other purpose across our operations," it said.

It remains to be seen how effective governments can be in sanctioning offending companies.

In 2014, Singapore passed the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act which allows the government to take action against local and foreign firms found to be contributing to the haze.

The following year when Singapore saw a bad bout of haze, authorities issued summonses to several Indonesian companies thought to have cleared land by burning, in a bid to prosecute them under the new law.

But that drew sharp ire from Jakarta, which said the move harmed bilateral ties. And with Indonesia refusing to cooperate, Singapore authorities said they could not obtain information about the suspected companies.

Also in 2015, Indonesia's then-vice-president Jusuf Kalla angered Singaporeans when he said that "for 11 months, they enjoyed nice air from Indonesia and they never thanked us... they have suffered because of the haze for one month and they get upset".

Similar tensions surfaced again last weekend when Syahganda Nainggolan, who leads the Indonesian government's communications agency, said the raging wildfires were beyond human control and added that the oxygen in neighbouring Singapore and Malaysia "also comes from our forests".

"When there is no smoke, we send oxygen," he added, in a video that has been widely circulated on social media, triggering criticism and ridicule from Malaysians and Singaporeans.

But in the past Indonesia has also apologised to its neighbours for causing the haze.

This year, Indonesian officials have thanked Singapore and Malaysia for offering to help tackle the wildfires, though Jakarta has not officially requested international support.

In Indonesia, there have been efforts by civil society groups to force the government to take action.

In Pontianak in the West Kalimantan province, several groups have filed a class action lawsuit against the Indonesian government and Prabowo, accusing them of "gross negligence" over recurrent toxic haze.

They want the government to declare the haze a national disaster, which would allow for recovery measures such as the covering healthcare costs.

A similar case was filed last year in South Sumatra but was dismissed.

Meanwhile, on the ground in Kalimantan and Sumatra, air pollution levels have been at dangerous levels for weeks.

There are many who have no choice but to brave the toxic smog every day.

"I'm short of breath and have a headache from breathing this air. But I still have to work," Imrayedi, a 63-year-old motorcycle taxi driver in Pekanbaru city, on Sumatra island, told BBC Indonesian last week.

"The government must also think about common people like us. Please take action to find a solution so that this haze problem can be resolved immediately."

items.title: Why the lonely in China are hiring 'temporary children'
items.summary: A new industry being dubbed the “loneliness economy” has emerged in China, with people hiring themselves out as companions to help the elderly.
items.content:
In China's cities, despite the huge crowds, or maybe because of them, residents can feel very isolated.

Now, a new industry being dubbed the "loneliness economy" has emerged, with people hiring themselves out as companions to help the elderly.

The BBC's China correspondent Stephen McDonell visits a company that does just that, to see how their business works.

Read more about the paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely.

items.title: Sportwashing e conti falsi: tutti i guai del Manchester City
items.summary: Outlook del 14 ottobre. Iscriviti alla Newsletter
items.content:
Benvenuti su Outlook, la newsletter di Repubblica che analizza l'economia, la finanza, i mercati internazionali. Ogni mercoledì parleremo di società quotate e no, di personaggi, istituzioni, di scandali e inchieste legate a questo mondo. Se volete scrivermi, la mia mail è w.galbiati@repubblica.it.

“Vergogna, colpevoli, imbroglioni”. Così lo scorso fine settimana gridavano dagli spalti i tifosi del Liverpool ai giocatori del Manchester City o meglio dello “Shamcester City” , (la squadra dei “falsari”) al loro primo ritorno in campo dopo che la Premier League ha accusato il club di aver truccato i conti del bilancio .

Sport… Stasera sarà la volta della Champions League , ma i Citizens giocheranno in casa, tra le mura amiche, contro il Paris Saint-Germain . La vittoria per 3 a 0 sui Reds lascia ben sperare per i risultati calcistici, mentre sul fronte dell’inchiesta sportiva il tentativo di trovare un accordo finanziario è fallito .

… e giustizia . Secondo i rumors della stampa inglese, la transazione si sarebbe dovuta incentrare su un ingente pagamento di denaro per evitare una eventuale retrocessione , la penalizzazione di punti o la revoca dei titoli .

La Lega inglese, però, non ha ceduto e ha preferito lasciare che l’ inchiesta faccia il suo corso piuttosto che attirarsi le critiche di tutti gli altri club che non sarebbero stati certo felici per una soluzione senza nessun riscontro sportivo .

I precedenti . In passato c’erano già stati casi simili. Il Chelsea se la cavò con una multa , mentre l’ Everton e il Nottingham Forest incassarono una penalizzazione .

Ma, se le accuse dovessero essere confermate , vista la loro gravità, questa volta è molto probabile che il City debba scontare qualcosa di più pesante , compresa una possibile retrocessione in B .

Conta sì il denaro . Si tratta di una questione di soldi , non perché ce ne sono pochi e si rischia il fallimento. Al contrario ce ne sono molti e non si sa più come farli entrare nelle casse del club .

I fondi arabi . Il tema è esploso con l’ingresso dei ricchissimi fondi sovrani arabi nel capitale delle squadre di calcio europee .

L’incontro di Champions tra Manchester City e Paris Saint-Germain è forse il simbolo che meglio rappresenta questa tendenza, lo sportwashing , ovvero la pratica di investire nello sport, per ripulire l’immagine dei Paesi dei fondi compratori attraverso le gesta sportive e le relazioni che ne derivano.

Il Psg e il Qatar . Dal 2011 il Paris Saint-Germain è di proprietà del Qatar Sports Investments , un fondo sovrano del Qatar, riconducibile a Nasser Al-Khelaïfi , un imprenditore considerato braccio destro e uomo di massima fiducia dell'emiro qatariota, T amim bin Hamad Al Thani .

City ed Emirati . Ma il primo grande acquisto di un club fu realizzato nel 2008 dall’ Abu Dhabi United Group for Development and Investment (Adug), una società di private equity degli Emirati Arabi Uniti , che rilevò la maggioranza del Manchester City .

Le quote . Adug fa capo allo sceicco Mansur bin Zayed Al Nahyam , membro della famiglia reale degli Emirati Arabi Uniti e possiede l’ 81% del Manchester City , attraverso City Football Group , una multinazionale, il cui restante 18% è in mano a Silver Lake Partners , un fondo di private equity statunitense concentrato in investimenti tecnologici e sportivi, e l’ 1% a Citic group , un consorzio statale cinese.

Lo sportwashing . Queste due acquisizioni sono finite subito nella categoria dello sportswashing , la strategia con cui i leader politici o i Paesi sfruttano lo sport per migliorare la propria reputazione internazionale, distogliendo l'attenzione da questioni interne scomode e ottenendo vantaggi politici, economici e diplomatici.

Le accuse . In questi anni, Amnesty International e organizzazioni come Human Rights Watch hanno accusato il Qatar e gli Emirati Arabi Uniti di gravi limitazioni delle libertà fondamentali , dalla libera espressione alla discriminazione di genere fino alla persecuzione degli oppositori politici, ma anche di sfruttamento dei lavoratori e di politiche ambientali pessime.

La crescita . Eppure, queste accuse non hanno fermato la loro espansione: il City Football Group sotto il vessillo del Manchester City è riuscito a costruire una rete internazionale che oggi controlla numerosi club sparsi in giro per il mondo in Europa, Asia e nelle Americhe, con una capacità di influenza notevole.

Trofei e soldi . Il prestigio arriva con le vittorie e i titoli sportivi , ma per ottenerli servono grandi investimenti , soprattutto nei campioni .

La truffa . La Commissione indipendente che ha lavorato sul dossier Manchester City per la Premier League ha riscontrato che Adug avrebbe versato enormi somme di denaro al club sotto forma di false sponsorizzazioni .

I numeri sono impressionanti . Dal 2009 al 2018 il City avrebbe registrato a bilancio 949,94 milioni di sterline come ricavi commerciali da sponsor provenienti da Abu Dhabi.

In realtà, di questa cifra, solo 119,25 milioni erano veri contratti di sponsorizzazione.

I restanti 830,69 milioni non sarebbero stati altro che iniezioni di capitale camuffati da sponsorizzazioni per aggirare le regole del fair play finanziario .

Ma non è tutto . Il club avrebbe utilizzato anche una società di facciata la Fordham sport management per pagare direttamente i calciatori del City per lo sfruttamento dei loro diritti d'immagine .

In questo modo, il club avrebbe fatto sparire dai propri bilanci ufficiali e dai controlli circa 49,4 milioni di sterline di spese per gli stipendi dei giocatori, facendole pagare segretamente alla proprietà.

Il Fair play . Le regole Uefa sui ricavi sono abbastanza chiare. Le società di calcio possono destinare fino al 70% dei propri introiti agli stipendi dei giocatori e all’ammortamento dei cartellini. E per pagarli, ai ricavi non si possono sommare gli aumenti di capitale o i finanziamenti soci da parte dei proprietari.

I controlli . Per questo motivo la Uefa e i campionati locali monitorano che le entrate sotto forma di sponsorizzazioni siano innanzitutto contratti veri e in secondo luogo non siano gonfiati , per evitare che i soldi degli azionisti piovano nelle casse dei club aggirando le regole Uefa .

Lo stesso discorso vale per i contratti di immagine , qualora a erogarli non siano controparti vere, ma gli stessi proprietari.

L’obiettivo . L’intento di chi controlla il Manchester City è chiaro: mettere più soldi possibile nel club non tanto per salvare i bilanci da un possibile fallimento, vista la ricchezza degli azionisti, ma per usarli e ottenere più prestigio sportivo e internazionale .

Il conto economico . L’ultimo bilancio depositato dal City restituisce l’immagine di una società in regola. Nel 2025 i ricavi del club sono stati di 694,1 milioni di sterline , in calo dai 715 milioni dell’anno prima per l’uscita prematura dalla Champions League .

Le spese . I costi per lo staff , compresi gli stipendi dei calciatori , sono stati di poco superiori ai 400 milioni di sterline, quindi ben a l di sotto del 70% (485 milioni) dei ricavi richiesto dai limiti Uefa .

Le partite di campionato hanno generato ricavi per 75,1 milioni di sterline, con un leggero calo di 0,5 milioni di sterline rispetto all’anno precedente.

Dai diritti televisivi sono arrivati 278,6 milioni di sterline, anche qui con una diminuzione di 16,1 milioni di sterline sia per l’eliminazione anticipata dalla Champions League sia per le minor partite della Premier trasmesse in Tv.

Infine gli altri ricavi commerciali ,che comprendono anche le sponsorizzazioni,sono stati pari a 340,4 milioni di sterline, con un calo di 4,3 milioni di sterline.

Le cessioni . Oltre ai ricavi, al bilancio concorrono, ma su un’altra riga, le compravendite . Nel 2025 il City ha generato 95,2 milioni di sterline dalla cessione dei propri calciatori , il terzo risultato più alto nella storia del Club contro i 139 milioni dell’anno precedente.

Il valore del brand . Il giro di affari è imponente, tanto che il Manchester City è considerato il marchio calcistico più prezioso della Premier League con un valore di 1,44 miliardi , davanti al Liverpool ( 1,4 miliardi ) e al Manchester United ( 1,2 miliardi ).

Il buco . Ma se si dovessero togliere 900 milioni di sterline di ricavi, circa 90 milioni per ognuno degli anni sotto indagine, il club non solo avrebbe sforato il tetto del 70% degli ingaggi, ma non avrebbe potuto nemmeno essere competitivo e portare a casa i titoli che ha vinto.

I risultati . Da quando è sotto la guida del fondo di Abu Dhabi , il City è tornato alla vittoria dopo 44 anni di astinenza e ha messo in bacheca otto Premier League , una Champions, una Supercoppa Uefa , una Coppa del Mondo per club , quattro Fa Cup , sette Coppe di Lega e quattro Community Shield .

Cosa rischia . In caso di colpevolezza nel periodo incriminato dal 2009 al 2018 , potrebbero essere revocate tre Premier League , una Fa Cup e tre Coppe di Lega .

“Se fossi un giocatore del Manchester City, getterei quelle medaglie nella spazzatura . Senza alcun dubbio”, ha dichiarato Roy Keane , uno spettatore tutt’altro che disinteressato vista la sua lunga militanza nella squadra rivale del Manchester United .

items.title: AlphaNIST
items.summary: Article URL: https://alpha-nist.github.io/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50079464 Points: 78 # Comments: 26
items.content:
From AlphaGo to AlphaZero , reinforcement learning produced strategies that surprised expert players. AlphaZero learned from experience at scale, without human demonstrations.

AlphaNIST brings this philosophy to contact-rich, high-precision robotic assembly in simulation. An end-to-end policy learns how to complete the task, without prescribed manipulation stages.

Four successful ten-part runs, using a policy trained separately from the single-component policy below.

The NIST board has twenty assembly tasks, with parts as small as 4 mm. Fitting one part can take several changes of grasp and orientation. Tight clearances leave little room for error: a tilted nut can jam or cross-thread.

With several parts, the robot also has to choose an order. An installed component may block the gripper’s next move.

Trying to prescribe every maneuver means anticipating how the robot should respond as contacts and obstructions change. A two-finger gripper may also need solutions quite different from those that come naturally to a human hand.

Perhaps the answer is to stop telling the robot how we think the task should be done, and let it learn how to get there. We give it a binary task reward for success and train it through vast amounts of diverse experience. That leaves room for the robot to discover solutions we might never have thought to teach.

One policy trains across twenty heterogeneous assemblies, starting from loose parts, in-hand grasps, and partial assemblies cached in simulation.

Near-complete starts let the robot practice finishing an assembly before it can solve the whole task. The cache supplies starting states, not demonstrations.

Beta sampling favors starting states the policy solves about half the time, while giving every state a chance. Progress on one state can make another solvable; its sampling weight then changes with new outcomes.

With binary task rewards, one policy trained across all twenty tasks reaches higher training success than twenty separate specialists. Adding rewards for reaching and alignment reduces success in this experiment.

items.title: Esecuzione in diretta streaming, almeno 60 soldati si rifiutano di fucilare Hasan
items.summary: Sono decine i militari che hanno chiesto di non partecipare all’uccisione dell’autore della strage di Fort Hood
items.content:
Un’esecuzione “grottesca e barbarica”. Così decine di militari hanno definito la decisione del capo del Pentagono Pete Hegseth di trasmettere in diretta streaming la fucilazione di Nidal Hasan e hanno chiesto di non parteciparvi.

L’organizzazione senza scopo di lucro, la Military religious freedom foundation , ha rivelato che le obiezioni dei soldati sono di carattere religioso o morale. “Chi si è opposto – ha spiegato Mikey Weinstein, fondatore dell’organizzazione no profit – ora rischia di essere incluso tra i 180 militari selezionati per il plotone. Ma un conto è eseguire un ordine di esecuzione, ben altra cosa è trasmetterla in streaming, permettendo a ogni bambino di seconda elementare in grado di usare internet di guardarla in diretta”.

Hasan, ex maggiore dell’esercito, nel 2009 uccise 13 soldati americani e ferì altre 52 persone durante un attacco alla base militare di Fort Hood , in Texas, dove prestava servizio come psichiatra. Rimase parzialmente paralizzato e costretto sulla sedia a rotelle dopo essere stato ferito dalla polizia al momento dell’arresto. Se Hasan non presenterà ricorso, l’esecuzione avverrà il prossimo 3 dicembre : si tratterebbe della prima fucilazione dal 1945 . L’ultima condanna a morte eseguita da militari risale al 1961, quando John Bennett fu impiccato per stupro e tentato omicidio.

Il vicepresidente statunitense JD Vance ha dichiarato che non assisterà alla diretta. “Quest'uomo ha commesso il peggior attacco terroristico sul suolo americano, al di fuori dell'11 settembre – ha spiegato - Se alla fine verrà trasmessa in diretta, io non la guarderò".

Una scelta, quella dell’uccisione in streaming, che l’ Onu ha già condannato come possibile forma di tortura, e metterebbe gli Usa sullo stesso piano di Paesi che accusano di violare i diritti umani, come l’Iran.

items.title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office
items.summary: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.
items.content:
A Saudi national has been charged with secretly planting a recording device in one of OpenAI's offices in California, federal prosecutors announced.

Abdulrahman Alfozan, who worked at the AI firm as an engineer, was charged federally with using or endeavouring to use an electronic, mechanical, or other device to intercept oral communications.

OpenAI said it had discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in their San Francisco office and alerted the FBI. The company said it used its AI models to track that it had been planted by an employee.

Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

OpenAI, the maker of the popular chatbot ChatGPT, said that it has no indication that source code, model weights or customer data were inappropriately accessed or taken in the incident. It said the employee has been fired.

According to the complaint, Alfozan "allegedly concealed a covert recording device inside his employer's executive conference room to secretly capture sensitive communications," FBI Director Kash Patel said in a statement.

Patel said that the alleged goal was to capture information about the company's AI product.

Alfozan has been working as an engineer at OpenAI since July 2025, prosecutors say.

On 30 September, OpenAI employees discovered the device - two days after prosecutors say it had been installed. The device was encrypted, prosecutors said.

OpenAI said they were able to use their AI models "to understand the device and where it had come from, identifying that a specific employee had planted it a few days earlier".

According to the FBI, the suspect used a "productivity tool" and a "chatbot" to research sensitive locations at OpenAI and how to secretly place audio equipment.

Chatbot prompts that he is alleged to have searched include "building, customising, installing, audio recording, testing, obfuscating, and remote accessing a device", prosecutors allege.

He is also accused of using the chatbot to ask about "'build[ing] a continuous audio recorder,' 'customis[ing] Wi-Fi . . . connectivity,' 'improv[ing] audio and live listening,' and 'encrypt[ing] the SD card'".

On 5 October, prosecutors say he allegedly returned to inspect the device in the office room. Prosecutors used CCTV camera footage to link him to the scene.

That same day, Alfozan left a bag unattended in a different part of the building. A security team for OpenAI opened it to find his wallet and ID, as well as another recording device that was similar to the one found in the office conference room, prosecutors said.

Alfozan appeared in court on Tuesday. It's unclear whether he has legal representation.

If found guilty, he faces up to five years in prison and a fine of $250,000 (£187,000).
